scope: Normal player-style party member debuff icons and their preview; retain raid cell and focus appearance.

nativeSource.contract: Existing CustomAuraButton AddDispelTypeTexture native color/visibility ownership; party-created decoration is prepared before restriction. No new native API.

implementation: Every party left-side aura category gets an inner solid red rim and dark inner backing on the existing text host above the cooldown swipe. Non-dispellable/plain mode still has a visible edge.
Existing native dispel-color texture moves above the party cooldown; native owner still controls its color/visibility. Ordinary raid decoration retains its old parent/draw layer.

Readable fallback and party preview use the same prepared edges and public DebuffTypeColor. Borders stay inside icons; preserve zero gaps, dimensions, aura alpha, timers, counts, strict filtering and Flux input.
resources: 8 textures per prepared party debuff icon; reuse existing above-cooldown text host. No added frame/event/hook/ticker/timer or per-frame work. Readable/preview color refreshes reuse edges. No native timing/performance claim.
nativePending: Current-client pixels, perceived contrast, actual secret/protected VM, taint and performance unverified. Desktop fixture checks establish construction/layer/filter ownership only.
recovery: Dated selected before-source.zip and verified all-history bundle outside AddOns;45 settings metadata entries read-only; prior full source/private recovery retained. No foreground/input/WTF/profiler/settings writes, manual sync, branch/commit/push.
